name: KV-Bound Ephemeral Projection Recovery
preconditions: purpose and projection schema bound before invocation
KV/SKAP Vault remains sole user-verification authority
consumer callback accepts the validated projection without inheriting component authority
canonical_implementation_owner: StegVerse-Labs/Site existing Device-KV projection/recovery surfaces, parameterized by consuming Goal Task

authority_owner.credential_provider_release: TV/TVC when downstream consumer requires provider operation
authority_owner.claim_fence: WorkerCoordinator when task execution requires claim/fence

expected_evidence: no browser persistence of projection state
exact fail-closed classification when recovery cannot proceed
retry_or_reentry_semantics: Fail closed. Automatic generic retry is prohibited. If and only if resident KV installation is not verified, an owner-selected canonical installation receipt may be admitted through the existing Device-KV path and the same purpose-bound projection may be retried. Other failures return exact evidence to the consuming Goal Task.
invariants: component does not mint InTr authority
component does not mint claim or fence
component does not create device-local user verification
device identity and transport identity are not user-verification authority
canonical installation receipt is never synthesized
GitHub and HeartBeat have no runtime authority
